name: Laguna
services: Site design, landscape design, exterior lighting
title: Laguna: Multifamily Pool & Landscape, San Diego | Atmos
description: Site and landscape design for a 16-unit San Diego apartment community: a resort-style pool, bocce court, turf lawn, lounge areas and private yards.
summary: A resort-inspired core anchors this 16-unit community with a pool, bocce court, turf lawn and lounge seating, while private yards extend outdoor living to every resident.
cover_alt: Design rendering of the Laguna community pool with palms, lounge seating and umbrellas

p: Laguna is organized around a resort-inspired core that anchors the site with a pool, bocce ball court, turf lawn and lounge seating. Crape myrtles and palms reinforce the Southern California character, while private yards extend that sense of outdoor living to residents.
The client, a progressive urban development firm, wanted a multi-unit community that pairs eco-conscious design with community-focused spaces while holding to a mid-range budget.

ul: Site plan, landscape plan and exterior lighting plan for the community
A communal pool and relaxation space, plus private yards for residents
Efficient circulation between units, community space, parking and trash areas
Efficient lighting and low-water plants and trees
Half an acre of flat land, two-story buildings, 16 apartments
Amenities: private community pool, bocce ball court, lounge areas

credits: Site & landscape design: Atmos Design Build, LLC

name: Crestview

p: Perched on an elevated corner lot with sweeping ocean views, Crestview offers thoughtfully designed residences that balance privacy with community living. Ground-floor residents step directly into private yards with views of the coast, while a central courtyard creates an inviting shared space for gathering and relaxation.
The client asked for a community that integrates eco-conscious design, urban greenery and community-focused spaces on a mid-to-high budget.

name: Woodline
title: Woodline: Hillside Multifamily Landscape | Atmos
description: Site and landscape design for a 12-residence hillside community in San Diego: terraced retaining walls, horizontal wood fencing and private yards.
summary: Material continuity drives this hillside community. Horizontal wood fencing, terraced retaining walls and private yards echo the buildings' wood entry paneling from the street to the canyon edge.
cover_alt: Woodline hillside residences with terraced wood fencing and new planting

p: The design is driven by material continuity. Horizontal wood fencing runs throughout the site in dialogue with the buildings' wood entry paneling. A continuous retaining wall capped with fencing creates a rhythmic, warm procession through the project, and terraced grade changes are handled with understated walls that keep the focus on the material palette.

A private residential developer wanted to transform a sloped hillside property into an infill community that emphasizes privacy, thoughtful site integration and a strong connection between architecture and outdoor living.

ul: Site and landscape design for a multi-unit community with private outdoor spaces, responsive to the site's topography
Terraced grading, retaining walls, fencing and layered landscape for seamless transitions across the property
A landscape palette that complements the architecture, with warm wood detailing and clean modern forms
A consistent use of wood, concrete and layered planting gives the whole development one identity
Thoughtful grading and terraced transitions tie the buildings into the natural hillside
Close coordination with contractors and fabricators kept fencing, walls and detailing precisely aligned

credits: Site & landscape design: Atmos Design Build, LLC

name: Takibi Supesu
title: Takibi Supesu: Outdoor Kitchen & Lounge Design | Atmos
description: Design for a Japanese-inspired outdoor lounge in Vista, CA: a fire pit gathering area and covered outdoor kitchen in wood and stone with lantern lighting.
summary: A Japanese-inspired outdoor lounge organized around a fire pit and a covered outdoor kitchen, lit by lantern-style pendants. The kind of amenity space guests remember.
cover_alt: Rendering of an outdoor kitchen and bar under a timber awning with lantern pendants at dusk

p: Takibi Supesu turns leftover yard space into a retreat: a place to gather around fire, cook outdoors and linger after dark. The design finds beauty in the natural variation of wood and stone, pairing the two into a warm, quiet outdoor room.

Lantern-style pendants with a koshi-moyo lattice pattern and cloth diffusion soften the light, with low-level accent lighting at paths, steps and planting edges so the fire stays the brightest element in the space.

ul: Lounge centered on a fire pit with built-in and loose seating
Outdoor kitchen with an attached awning tied back to the building
A wood and stone material palette that embraces grain and texture
Lantern-style pendant lighting with layered low-level accent lights
Design documentation and renderings for review
